facts.business: Avantel Limited designs, develops, and manufactures Software Defined Radios, Wind Profiler Radar systems, SATCOM ground station systems, and other defence electronics, while its subsidiary Imeds Global Private Limited focuses on indigenous medical devices such as CPAP, BiPAP, ventilators, and patient monitoring systems.

capacity_or_capex.item: Unit No. 2 facility at E City, Raviryal Mandal, Tukkuguda (4-acre land, 86,271 sq ft built-up)
Unit No. 3 facility at Kondaparva Village near Vijayawada (9-acre land, ~1,13,660 sq ft built-up) for SATCOM Ground Station Systems
Imeds Global facility at AMTZ, Visakhapatnam (2-acre land, ~36,000 sq ft built-up)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Order book of approximately ₹720 Crores to be executed across FY 2026-27 and FY 2027-28
Imeds Global division well-positioned to achieve profitability in the coming financial year

auditor.name: Grandhy & Co., Chartered Accountants (ICAI Firm Registration No. 001007S)

key_risks: High R&D expenditure impacting near-term profitability
Dependence on defence sector orders and government policy (Atmanirbhar Bharat)
Execution risk on large order book (₹720 Cr) across two financial years
Regulatory and certification delays in medical devices subsidiary (Imeds Global)
Subsidiary Imeds Global currently loss-making due to planned investments in R&D, regulatory approvals, and manufacturing readiness
facts.related_party_note: Imeds Global Private Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of Avantel Limited. Minutes of Board Meetings and Financial Statements of subsidiaries are placed before the Audit Committee and Board of Directors of Avantel Limited for review.
